name: deutschbahn
description: Comprehensive Deutsche Bahn transport information with station search, real-time departures/arrivals, facility status, and journey planning
long_description: A comprehensive Desktop Extension for accessing Deutsche Bahn transport information. Features include station search by name/location, detailed station information, real-time departure and arrival boards, facility status checks, and comprehensive journey planning with multiple transport options. All data is sourced from official Deutsche Bahn APIs with proper error handling and retry mechanisms.

tools.name: deutschbahn.searchStations
tools.description: Search for Deutsche Bahn stations by name, location, or coordinates. Returns station details including IDs, names, locations, and coordinates.

tools.name: deutschbahn.stationInfo
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Deutsche Bahn station including facilities, address, coordinates, and accessibility features.

tools.name: deutschbahn.departures
tools.description: Get real-time departure information for a specific station. Includes train types, destinations, platforms, delays, and cancellations.

tools.name: deutschbahn.arrivals
tools.description: Get real-time arrival information for a specific station. Includes train types, origins, platforms, delays, and cancellations.

tools.name: deutschbahn.facilityStatus
tools.description: Check the current operational status of facilities at Deutsche Bahn stations (elevators, escalators, accessibility features).

tools.name: deutschbahn.planJourney
tools.description: Plan a journey between two stations with comprehensive route options, including connections, durations, prices, and real-time information.

db_client_id.description: Client ID for Deutsche Bahn API access
